scripts.build: npm run build -w @hexvero/core -w @hexvero/mcp -w @hexvero/server -w hexvero && npm run build -w @hexvero/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/mcp packages/server packages/cli && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.publish:all: npm run check && npm run build && for w in packages/core packages/mcp packages/server packages/cli; do npm publish -w ./$w --access public; done
